visual.description: Two-part scene. Top: '3×' large stat in JetBrains Mono with 'higher chemical concentration in children's clothing vs adult' subtitle — uses tug-of-war bar format with Children (Accent Pink, higher) vs Adult. Bottom: Formaldehyde classification card — 'Group 1 Carcinogen' text in Negative Red, 'IARC Classification' label, '20% of clothing tested in Spain' stat. Flat surface for readability.
visual.sourceText: Source: IARC; Ji et al.; Herrero et al.

notes: The children's 3x stat is alarming — make the size difference visceral. Formaldehyde classification card should use Negative Red for 'Group 1 Carcinogen' to signal danger without being gratuitous.
